THE DEBUT POETRY COLLECTION

Us, Unscripted

a poetry collection · by Hishika Chandan

Growing up rarely comes with a script. These poems explore friendship, family, heartbreak, nostalgia, and the tender work of finding your way back to yourself.

For anyone caught between the person they used to be and the person they’re still becoming.

A NOTE FROM THE BACK COVER
Growing up rarely happens all at once.

It lives in quiet afternoons, unanswered questions, familiar places that slowly begin to feel different, and the moments that leave us changed without asking for permission.

These pages are an invitation to slow down, reflect, and find pieces of your own story hidden between the lines.

For every version of you
past, present, and still unfolding.
